newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gle des Eaux rises on profit recovery.
newsitem.headline: Gle des Eaux rises on profit recovery.

text.p: Shares in French utilities group Cie Generale des Eaux rose on Friday on the back of better than expected 1996 profits and forecast higher profit this year.
"The market is unanimous in welcoming the recovery in Generale des Eaux," a fund manager said.
The stock was up 1.91 percent at 748 francs at 1444 GMT, while the market was down 0.44 percent.
Generale des Eaux reported on Thursday net attributable profit of 1.95 billion francs, compared to the 1.8 billion expected by the market. It expects at least five billion francs net profit for 1997.
Cheuvreux de Virieu maintained its buy recommendation on the stock and raised its 1997 earnings per share forecast to 39.60 francs from 34.10 and to 41.20 francs, fund managers said.

The brokerage is holding its 1998 net profit forecast at 5.2 billion francs but expects the quality of earnings to be better, with a higher proportion of operating profit and lower financial results, they said.
Ferri and Dupont Denant also held their buy recommendations.
